MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
26000064
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F00366121
MEB LOAN TRUST IV, is the Plaintiff,
and DARYL MARTIN, ET ALS., are
Defendants, writ of execution For
the sale of mortgaged premises
dated 12/30/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 11TH DAY of
MARCH, A.D. 2026, at the hour of
one thirty by the then prevailing
(Standard or Daylight Saving) time,
in the afternoon of the said day, at
the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston
Ave. New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the TOWNSHIP OF SOUTH
BRUNSWICK, County of Middlesex,
State of New Jersey.
Being more commonly known as: 73
DEANS LANE, MONMOUTH JCT. NJ
08852.
Lot: 20.05; Block: 90.03.
Dimensions: Approximately 1.75 AC
Nearest Cross Street: RT 1,
UPSET PRICE: Approximately:
$365,846.23 and any additional
sums as ordered by the court.
OCCUPANCY STATUS: Occupied by
Unknown.
Beginning in the center of the road
leading from the New Brunswick
and Cranbury Turnpike to the Trentan Turnpike now known as Dean's
Lane, at a point therein distant 369
feet southerly from a corner of
lands formerly of Abigail Dumont,
said beginning point being also the
most southerly corner of a tract of
land conveyed by Anna Applegate
and Milton Applegate to Vinnocenzo Venza and Sebastiana Venza,
his wife, by a deed dated September 10, 1936 and recorded in the
Middlesex County Clerk's Office in
Book 1101 of Deeds on Page 300;
thence running (This concise
description does not constitute a
legal description. A copy of the full
legal description can be found at
the Office of the Sheriff.)
Pursuant to a tax search of 1/5/26;
2026 Qtr 1 Due: 02/01/2026
$2,401.88 OPEN, 2026 Qtr 2 Due:
05/01/2026 $2,401.87 OPEN. Water
Acct: 99937333 0 10/01/2025 -
12/31/2025 $58.36 OPEN PLUS
PENALTY $552.12 OPEN PLUS
PENALTY; OWED IN ARREARS
Subject to final reading. Sewer:
Acct: 99937333 0 01/01/2026 -
03/31/2026 $171.96 OPEN PLUS
PENALTY $569.40 OPEN PLUS
PENALTY; OWED IN ARREARS
Subject to final reading. Subject to
prior mortgage in favor of Pinter
Door Sales dated 2/16/1996,
recorded 2/26/1996, book 5039,
page 692 in the original amount of
$106,100.00. Subject to prior mortgage in favor of Washington Mutual
Bank, FA, A Federal Association
dated 9/22/2003, recorded
12/2/2003, book 9133, page 309 in
the original amount of $122,000.00
(pending foreclosure action in
regard to the aforementioned
mortgage under docket F-007775-
24 with 'US Bank Trust National
Association, no in its individual
capacity but solely as owner
trustee for RCAF Acquisition Trust'
as Plaintiff). Deponent does not
warrant the accuracy of this representation and herein makes no
representation regarding the status
of title. Interested parties are
advised to conduct and rely upon
their own independent investigation to ascertain whether there
exists any outstanding interests or
amounts due.
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES
THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE
WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE
THROUGH PUBLICATION.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of THREE HUNDRED EIGHT
THOUSAND NINE HUNDRED THIRTY
DOLLARS AND SIXTY FIVE CENTS
($308,930.65) DOLLARS more or
less, plus interest together with the
costs of this sale. THE UPSET
AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO
FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of
sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
FRENKEL, LAMBERT, WEISS, WEISMAN & GORDON, LLP
53 GIBSON STREET
BAY SHORE, NY 11706
Attorneys
